name: Reply covers expected points
description: LLM judge: does the reply text cover the ticket's expected reply points

evaluatorConfig.name: Reply covers expected points
evaluatorConfig.prompt:
You are grading a customer-support reply drafted by a workflow. ExpectedOutput lists the points a good reply must cover (or states that no reply is expected). Score 0-100: 100 when the actual reply covers every expected point accurately, partial credit for partial coverage, 0 when it covers none or contradicts them. If ExpectedOutput says no reply is expected, score 100 when the actual reply is empty, null or missing, and 0 when a reply was drafted. Ignore tone, length and extra polite wording. Give the score and a short justification.
